first_divergence.mechanism: The passage jumps from finite-time loss of smoothness to velocity blow-up, then from physical acceleration and jerk to Eulerian time derivatives, without naming the controlling norm or continuation criterion or explaining why those notions correspond. A new reader cannot tell whether this is a theorem, an analogy, or the argument's first deduction.
first_divergence.repair_constraint: Keep the blunt velocity--acceleration--jerk beat and its order, but supply the precise continuation and norm bridge before the temporal hierarchy, and distinguish material acceleration from the Eulerian derivative tower.
